_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Wednesday — open-weight reckoning. (1) Meta debuts Muse Spark, first model from Meta Superintelligence Labs (codenamed 'Avocado'), the first major LLM since CAIO Alexandr Wang joined nine months ago (after $14.3B Scale AI 49% stake); AAII v4.0 score 52 — 4th behind Gemini 3.1 Pro / GPT-5.4 (57) and Opus 4.6 (53). Weights kept CLOSED — strategic pivot from Llama open-weight strategy; private API preview to select partners. CapEx guided to $115-135B (~2× 2025). Artificial Intelligence News + Simon Willison frame the closed-weight choice as the most material open-source AI setback of 2026 — Llama 4 was open-source baseline for ~40% of HF download volume; Muse Spark pulls Meta out of that role. New topic 'meta-muse-spark-pivot' spawns. (2) CoreWeave-Meta $21B expansion reporting begins surfacing (formal announcement Apr 9) — total backlog with Meta at ~$35B through 2032 + NVIDIA Vera Rubin first deployments. Wang→Muse Spark→CoreWeave/Rubin stack visible end-to-end in 24hr. (3) Glasswing aftermath ramp: WEF 'Mythos moment: how frontier AI is redefining cybersecurity' + ITECS 'end of secure-by-obscurity' + Internet Governance Project 'changing institutional economics of bugs' — Glasswing moves from lab announcement to governance template in 24 hours. (4) OpenAI Industrial Policy paper picks up global policy press: Bloomberg, OpenAI Forum, TechPolicy.Press 'policymercial' viral — sets stage for Treasury/Fed banks briefing Apr 10. Plus NVIDIA Agent Toolkit Adobe/Salesforce/SAP 17 adopters + HF Spring 2026 OSS report China share rising + Kai Waehner enterprise agentic AI landscape carry. Research: Claw-Eval trajectory-aware Pass@k AND Pass^k, Learning to Retrieve from Agent Trajectories, Beyond Accuracy/PTE (Prefill Token Equivalents — hardware-aware), How Well Do Agentic Skills Work in the Wild (counter-evidence to SkillX Tuesday — skill utilization degrades when retrieved vs handcrafted), In-Place Test-Time Training, ClawsBench productivity-agent benchmark, MegaTrain 100B+ single GPU, DARE diffusion LLM unified post-training, Personalized RewardBench, REAM router-weighted expert merging. STAGE MOVES: meta-muse-spark-pivot new → emerging.

DARE unified post-training stack for diffusion LLMs. In-Place Test-Time Training modifies final projection matrix in MLP blocks. REAM router-weighted expert merging beats pruning on Pareto frontier.

Weights closed — strategic pivot from Llama, private API preview only. NEW topic 'meta-muse-spark-pivot' spawns. Combined with DeepSeek V4 Apr 24 prep, this is the day the open-weight thesis loses its biggest US anchor. The Chinese-frontier-lab share of open-weight downloads (41% per HF Spring 2026 report) structurally set to climb. Voice/TTS drops to background — slow EMA below floor.
